fieldValues.title: What this is
fieldValues.article_text: LiMoMa — the Limehouse Museum of Maybe Art — is a community gallery initiative that uses the back stairs and landings of Limehouse Town Hall as a space for exhibiting artwork. It exists as a voluntary association of members with no formal legal status. The pilot runs for six months from June 2026.
fieldValues.rationale: The name and definition set the frame for all subsequent decisions. 'Maybe Art' signals that the space is exploratory — not a conventional gallery with commercial or institutional expectations.
fieldValues.amendment_rule: Unanimous agreement of all current members.
